step_a: Discover same-color four-connected nonzero components and select the unique largest by occupied cells.
intermediate: The selected object, its tight square bounding box, and its object-only cropped grid.
step_b: Rotate and tile that cropped grid into four quadrants under the episode handedness.
why_b_depends_on_a: The selected object determines the source pixels, color and side length consumed by tiling. Replacing only the selector with largest bounding-box area chooses the sparse distractor and changes the final output geometry and cells; the tiling code is identical.

cases.counterfactual_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
         (chosen (argmax (lambda (o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) objs))
         (bb (obj-bbox chosen))
         (cells (obj-cells chosen))
         (source (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                               (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))
                   (lambda (r c)
                     (if (member (list (+ r (first bb)) (+ c (second bb))) cells)
                         (obj-color chosen) 0)))))
    (stack-grids 'vertical
      (list (stack-grids 'horizontal (list source (rotate-cw source)))
            (stack-grids 'horizontal (list (rotate-ccw source) (rotate-180 source))))))))
